abstract: Let \(X\) be a smooth projective complex variety with a boundary divisor \(\Delta=\sum_{i=1}^s(1-1/m_i)D_i\) of simple normal crossings support and integers $m_i$. We prove that, if \(-(K_X+\Delta)\) is nef and big, then \((X,\Delta)\) is Campana rationally connected. We do this by constructing a free Campana rational curve whose class lies in the interior of the nef cone of curve classes and whose contacts with \(D_i\) have order \(m_i\) and avoid deeper strata. We construct such a curve from a free Campana curve by attaching to it free rational curves which intersect positively with divisors that span the cone of effective divisors, and smooth the resulting comb.
hook: Smooth weak log Fano orbifolds are proved Campana rationally connected.
summary: For a smooth projective variety with a boundary divisor whose negative log canonical class is nef and big, the pair is Campana rationally connected. The proof builds a free Campana rational curve with the right contact orders by attaching free rational curves and smoothing the comb. Applies only to smooth varieties with simple normal crossings boundary.
title: Smooth weak log Fano orbifolds are Campana rationally connected
